title: Recombining sign coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $ in n$. Given a sign assignment $y$ on $J$ and a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$, combine them into the sign vector on all $n$ coordinates that restricts to $y$ on $J$ and to $z$ outside $J$.
